messages.subject: effort misunderstanding
parts:
Hi there,
I have carried out a point count survey with 4 points in different areas (1 point per area) and each point was visited 80 times. I thus put the effort for each observation as 80 but the covered area has been calculated as the area covered by the point multiplied by 80. It looks like R has assumed I have covered 80 different points per area but only 4 points were covered and just visited 80 times meaning the covered area is 80x too large. How to I fix this so that the repeat measurements are accounted for but the covered area is not multiplied by the effort?
Thank you,
Rebecca
